visual.caption: 圖 1｜FTP 的兩類連線
visual.description: 控制與資料各自有責任。兩張卡是平行分類，不表示一條連線自動保證另一條成功。

items.title: 控制連線
items.body: 承接登入、功能詢問與操作要求，常用 TCP 21；登入成功仍須另外確認資料連線。

items.title: 資料連線
items.body: 承接目錄清單或檔案內容；主動／被動模式改變發起方向與接收位置。

visual.caption: Figure 1 | Two FTP connection roles
visual.description: These are parallel responsibilities, not a guarantee that success on one connection makes the other succeed.

items.title: Control connection
items.body: Carries login, capability queries, and operation requests, commonly on TCP 21. A successful login still needs a working data connection.

items.title: Data connection
items.body: Carries directory listings or file contents. Active/passive modes change the initiator and receiving endpoint.

visual.caption: 圖 2｜三項權限分開找證據
visual.description: 以下是三個獨立判斷，沒有必然先後或相互保證。

items.title: 名稱可見
items.body: 清單出現檔名與大小，支持看見中繼資料。

items.title: 內容可讀
items.body: 需要該檔案內容取得成功的證據；清單成功不等於下載成功。

items.title: 檔案可寫
items.body: 需要獲准的寫入驗證；本課範例沒有測試寫入。

visual.caption: Figure 2 | Separate three permissions
visual.description: These are independent judgments, not an inevitable sequence or mutual guarantees.

items.title: Visible name
items.body: A listing reveals a file name and size: evidence of visible metadata.

items.title: Readable contents
items.body: Requires evidence that the file content was obtained. A successful listing is not a successful download.

items.title: Writable file
items.body: Requires an authorized write check. This lesson does not test writing.
